mentions.h: Young Belgravians on the world stage

photos.c: Reigning European and World Junior 200 metre Champion and not to mention Belgrave club record holder over 100, 200 and 400 metres, Vernicha James still has another season in the Under 20 age group. With personal bests (so far) of 11.40, 22.93 and 53.84, her potential is frightening.
